scope.implemented: shared embedded fleet demultiplexing and bounded complete membership; validated native authoritative observer with independent age/per-vehicle times and read-only HUD
scope.not_implemented: fleet meshes, design/resource replication, common render epoch, remote interpolation, prediction/reconciliation

contract.transport: one existing reader dispatches PRIMARY/FLEET_SNAPSHOT; same generic inbox, at most two pending ingress packets plus drained previous/latest history per kind; independent generations and reader receive ages; PRIMARY interpolation unchanged
contract.membership: complete, strictly ascending unique non-primary IDs; empty packet clears membership; missing packet does not
contract.capacity: 64 total including PRIMARY, 63 secondaries; post-decode membership validation before retention; existing frame-byte limit still applies
contract.server_changes: broadcast empty membership as well as nonempty; share cap constant and correct split admission's off-by-one that previously allowed 64 secondaries despite documenting 64 total
contract.rejection: capacity failure leaves vehicle mass/topology/membership unchanged; rejection telemetry is published
contract.time: every checked pose subtracts the chosen reference ephemeris at that vehicle's own sample time; no simultaneous PRIMARY/fleet packet or primary-to-secondary distance is inferred
contract.native_transaction: validate whole fleet before replacing registry; continuing IDs cannot rewind tick/time; births/removals change the explicit set without blending or extrapolation
contract.stale: independent fleet reader age uses the native timeout; withhold stale rows but retain last-known membership; fresh PRIMARY can continue; frozen session is labeled separately
contract.invalid: malformed fleet payload/membership closes shared link; invalid/backwards consumed kinematics stop native with the existing freeze/no-fallback policy
contract.ui: stable ID, tick, own simulation time, reference-body radius and stopped status; no packet/fresh empty/stale/stopped are distinct; absent outside server mode, no UI clone/window work with --no-hud
contract.limits: count bound is not a bound on all transient decoder allocations or arbitrary nested wire strings; retained generations are bounded; not full hostile-server validation or per-vehicle progress detection

regressions: Shared inbox generation, original PRIMARY interpolation and reader-time behavior retained; fleet flooding retains two arrivals
Fleet/PRIMARY demultiplex independently through one actual child/reader; invalid ordering/duplicate IDs/PRIMARY membership/oversize fail; malformed fleet payload closes shared link
Physical server separation publishes the real secondary state through the outbound mailbox; subsequent explicit empty membership clears the old set
Full-cap admission includes PRIMARY and rejects the next split without changing vehicle mass or fleet membership
Whole-fleet pose validation and backwards-time rejection are transactional; own-time ephemeris subtraction error <1e-8 m; ID birth/removal and PRIMARY/input isolation
A continuously fresh PRIMARY stream does not reset fleet age or turn fleet silence into despawn
Actual default server acknowledges input and publishes empty fleets; native window receives multiple fleet updates
63-member synthetic peer reaches actual native headless CLI and HUD; all secondaries remain observations, not invented render meshes

verification.gpu_oracle_note: Initial attempt to apply the old full-right-column preservation oracle to a right-anchored inspector failed by one blue-channel value where its shadow legitimately reaches the edge. The original no-inspector full-column oracle is retained; inspector cases additionally verify an exact unchanged 32x32 lower-right patch outside both windows/shadows across resize/DPI/recreation. No pixel tolerance or production rendering change was used to mask the failure.
verification.not_run: existing ignored sim-core/flight-authority wall-clock profiling diagnostics; no new physical integration algorithm

real_server_smoke.scope: actual default server verifies explicit empty fleet plus existing PRIMARY input adoption; not a nonempty fleet replay or network performance benchmark

synthetic_fixture_capture.rendering_boundary: Fixture PRIMARY follows a synthetic position, not physics, reaches AGL=0 and puts the camera amid terrain occlusion. This image validates observer text/transport/capacity only, not terrain visibility or visual acceptance. No secondary meshes are drawn. Real-server release captures are recorded separately.

measurements.local_conclusion: identical final trajectory and geometry; new medians about 0.9-2.4% higher in this four-run sample with async publication/tail variance; no speedup, zero-overhead or isolated-adapter-cost claim
measurements.server_boundary: actual default server with zero secondaries; HUD/no-HUD end at different wall-time epochs and geometry, so these are not an isolated inspector-cost or matched-scene speed comparison; child CPU work concurrent

legacy_bevy_smoke.limitations: audio device warnings, audio unverified; not a matched native/Bevy epoch, resolution, material or effects comparison

limitations: No real-server nonempty fleet visual replay: default compatibility X-15 has no separable assembly. Nonempty transport/HUD coverage uses explicit fixtures; physical separation/state conservation is covered in server tests.
No design/model/reference-body identity or complete resources on this lean wire payload; observer uses PRIMARY's chosen reference body at each secondary's own time.
Outbound PRIMARY/fleet slots may coalesce independently; no paired-scene guarantee. Stagnant simulation time is valid while paused, so receive freshness alone is not proof of physical progress.
ID history is retained for current membership only; a removed/reintroduced ID is a new observation, not a persisted identity ledger.
Existing terrain seams/LOD, native flat sky/material/effects/UI parity, persistent GPU bisector topology, FastRT structures and platform recovery remain unresolved.
Captures are implementer diagnostics, not blind subjective acceptance, matched native/Bevy scenes or a whole-client replacement claim.
